moments.author: Tom Warren
moments.quote: I just went to write a tweet and a massive hand popped up pointing to the promote button 😵‍💫
moments.why: Users are freaking out over a bizarre ‘jump‑scare’ hand animation urging paid promotion during post composition.

moments.quote: I’m joining the team at @X to lead Product… it’s time to make shitposting multiplanetary.

moments.author: Sal Frelick (via news coverage)
